text.text_excerpt: I only have good things to say about our stay here while in New Orleans. The hotel is in a great, quiet location but very close and walkable to the French Quarter. A lot of restaurants nearby. The front doors were locked so you had to be buzzed in or have a hotel key. The hotel had very trendy, cool vibe with modern furnishings throughout. I would love to own every piece of furniture! Our room was very spacious and comfortable. We had a 2 queen bed suite with a pullout couch in a separate room that could be closed off with a door for privacy. There were two large TVs, as well as a Keurig and a mini fridge for your own drinks. An additional PLUS if you are a Peloton user... there is a Pelo...

We had the opportunity to stay here and it is definitely a new hotel. We were told it used to be a Comfort Inn. This is a high end hotel that has an industrial loft feel. They did a great job with the décor as the pieces in the main areas and the rooms make it feel very industrial chic. The fixtures within the rooms are all gold, with a blue black and white accent. The tile is nice and very unique to a hotel. There is no closed off closet, but a decent space to hang your clothes and place your luggage. Now for the faults. This is a gorgeous hotel! I've never stayed here but I enjoy their lobby bar and the restaurants inside! It's a great place to pop in for a drink and bite and to look around the gorgeous space.
